Dried White Raisins (Whole, Seedless – Natural Sultanas)

Tufan Organik Dried White Raisins (Whole, Seedless – Natural Sultanas) belongs to the Dried Fruits range. It is a natural food with roots in Gürün/Sivas; contact us for product, packaging and order details.

Helle Rosinen (ganz, kernlos – natürliche Sultaninen)
